neighbours.label: A trace left by something that passed: shadows cast, footprints, tracks, impressions in the ground; the same scenes with no trace stay low.
fire: At dusk the towers cast long shadows across the square.
Move your hand and watch how its shadow changes on the wall.
Hikers found bear footprints in the soft mud.
The tractor crossed the field, leaving deep tracks in the clay.
Shale can preserve ripple marks and raindrop impressions.
Rain filled the footprints that the deer had left.
The moon rover left wheel tracks in the grey dust.
Under the lamp, her shadow stretched along the corridor.
quiet: At dusk the towers looked golden above the square.
Move your hand and watch how the ring shines on your finger.
Hikers found bear warnings on the trail signs.
The tractor crossed the field and stopped by the barn.
Shale can contain oil and natural gas.
Rain filled the barrels that the farmer had left.
The moon rover sent new pictures to Earth.
Under the lamp, her book lay open on the desk.

predictions: 7/8 fire, 0 near misses. A shared pattern instead of a noun list.
